Q8060.reason: Austin, author of The Province of Jurisprudence Determined, called jurisprudence the philosophy of positive law as the sovereign's command backed by sanction.

Q8095.reason: A five-month-old is still in the indiscriminate-attachment phase and will accept an unfamiliar adult, while stranger wariness begins only around six or seven months.

Q5546.reason: The accidental fire and smoke came from careless upkeep of flammable residue, so recovery rests on breach of reasonable care rather than an intentional invasion.
